items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 vs JAX (hamstring), along with Tank Bigsby (IR), DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown. Eagles backfield to Shipley/Pierce.
items.why: Final injury report; hamstring, DNP all week.
items.implication: Start Shipley as lead back; fade Eagles pass catchers slightly without Smith.
items.opportunity: RB1 workload for Shipley in London game

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle) for Week 5 at ATL. Huntley expected to start.
items.why: Final report; ankle injury confirmed by coach/insiders.
items.implication: Fade Ravens stack; Likely/Flowers still viable but lower ceiling without Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Week 5 vs CLE, second straight miss. AD Mitchell also OUT.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full lead role again.

items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring); Jayden Daniels will start vs NYG.
items.implication: Daniels full go boosts Commanders offense; McLaurin/others elevated without Diggs.
items.opportunity: McLaurin target share up; Daniels rushing/passing volume

items.text: Chris Olave listed IN (with Noah Fant) for Week 5.
Mike Evans off injury report, no designation for 49ers vs SEA. Juszczyk and Bosa OUT.
items.implication: Start without concern; Purdy stack viable.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (IN) despite ankle maintenance/limited practice. Projects 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much better role/workload after Week 4 criticism.
items.why: No final report listing; media drag may force more usage; gut says better role though downside risk remains.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start; clear lead over Allgeier.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt, James).
items.implication: Ladd McConkey and others see boosted targets.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume + matchup vs soft Titans secondary.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injuries (Chase/Higgins Q) could boost; nickname push 'Brown Gobbler'.
items.why: Soft run D matchup + potential pass-game spillover if WRs limited.

items.text: Broncos place WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle); misses next 4, returnable Week 9ish. Humphrey promoted.
items.why: Ankle from prior game; short-term IR.
items.implication: Opens WR snaps for others in DEN.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: sore knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching staff style. Frustration over low 2nd-half targets noted. Playing this week but stacked risks.
items.why: Knee + shoulder + QB/coaching concerns compound; not big single-week risk.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; still startable short-term but caution on value.

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London (QB15); rough stretch + banged-up line.
items.why: Inefficiency + OL issues + London travel/Barkley out context.
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options; lower floor.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume and red-zone usage.
